news.headline: DODGERS FAN REFUSES TO GIVE FOUL BALL TO LITTLE KID — ENTIRE STADIUM TURNS ON HIM
news.summary: Dodgers fan caught foul ball at NLDS Tuesday and refused on camera to give it to a young Braves fan. He posed with the ball as the disappointed kid was filmed.
news.signal: 2.6M views on X repost in ~12h, ~1M TikTok views

news.headline: 67-YEAR-OLD WOMAN DOES DRUNK DONUTS ON COURTHOUSE LAWN — ARRESTED ON CAMERA
news.summary: Sheriff video shows 67-year-old Indiana woman allegedly driving drunk in circles on courthouse lawn, hitting a sign. Arrested on OWI charges, $950 bond, no injuries.
news.signal: Sheriff video released, TMZ + NY Post Oct 6-7

news.headline: CHET HANKS CONFRONTS ERIC ANDRE AT COMPLEXCON — SECURITY FORCED TO STEP IN
news.summary: Chet Hanks confronted Eric Andre at ComplexCon LA over years-old show comments. Shouting match caught on video, security removed Andre.
news.signal: TMZ-obtained viral clip, Page Six Oct 7

news.headline: FLYING TAXI COMPANY HIT WITH $100 MILLION VERDICT — JURY SIDES WITH SUPPLIER
news.summary: Federal jury awarded supplier Aerosonic over $100M against Joby Aviation, alleging Joby used its proprietary probe designs after an NDA. Joby had countersued.

news.headline: ZENDAYA ROASTED FOR NOT STANDING TO GREET FRANCE'S FIRST LADY — VIRAL VIDEO SPARKS BACKLASH
news.summary: At Louis Vuitton Paris show Oct 7, Zendaya stayed seated shaking hands with First Lady Brigitte Macron. Clip split comments: rude vs US etiquette debate.
news.signal: Encounter video viral on social Oct 7

news.headline: MAYOR SHIELDS STUDENT PROTESTERS FROM POLICE — GETS TEAR-GASSED ON VIRAL VIDEO
news.summary: Saint-Denis mayor stood in front of student protesters in Paris telling police not to charge. He told Reuters Oct 7 police fired tear gas at the group including him.

news.headline: CAMP SETTLES GROOMING LAWSUIT FOR $15 MILLION — EVERY LEVEL FAILED
news.summary: $15M settlement reached Oct 7 in Allegheny County suit alleging a camp employee groomed and assaulted a minor. Counsel said failures at every level allowed it.
